description: Create a diagram in AI Flowchart from a plain-English description and get a link that opens it as an editable board (edit, present as an animated slideshow, export PNG/PDF/PowerPoint). Flowcharts, sequence diagrams and mind maps also come back as Mermaid code. Types: flowchart, mindmap, sequence (API / login flows), erdiagram (database), systemdesign (architecture), swimlane, bpmn (BPMN 2.0 business process), orgchart, uml_class, uml_usecase, uml_state, uml_activity, timeline, gantt (project plan), chart (bar/line/pie… from data you describe). Uses 1 AI credit; advanced types need AI Flowchart Pro.

description.description: What to draw, in detail: the process, system, data, steps or numbers. Include names and specifics from the conversation.

name: create_diagram
title: Create a diagram
